name: B. Nathaniel Bespoke (B. Nathaniel Custom Clothier)
what_they_do: Custom clothier and menswear shop at 28 Paterson St selling men's suits, custom clothing, shoes, wedding packages for whole groomsmen parties and alterations, with home or office visits available. The process is appointment-led: consultation, over 20 measurements, then fittings. Also runs a small online shop by category plus an email list.
customers: Grooms and wedding parties, professionals needing suits, and walk-ins for alterations; also corporate and at-home clients.

size_signals.signal: 'Est. 1974' mark in the logo; positions itself as one of the best suit providers in the nation
Store hours Mon-Fri 9:00-18:30, Sat 9:00-14:00; single Paterson St address; staff referred to generically as 'a member of our staff'
497 reviews at 4.8 average - high volume of completed fittings for a one-location shop
Offers home and office visits, i.e. tailors travel to the customer

listing.platform: Birdeye (mirror of Google review data, profile claimed)

website_review.primary_cta: Shop Now / Book Now (both lead to a shop grid or the contact page)
website_review.online_booking_or_quote: contact form only - 'Book Now' goes to /contact, with no calendar or time slots
website_review.trust_signals: 497 reviews at 4.8, 'Est. 1974', gallery page, wedding packages, step-by-step process description; no licence badges needed for this trade
website_review.out_of_date_signs: footer copyright reads 2026 so the year is current; weak signals otherwise - appointments still phone-only
website_review.search_basics: title 'Men's Suits | New Brunswick, NJ | 732-735-1480' and the description both name the service and town; service categories have their own URLs (/shop-mens-suits/...), but structured data is a single WebSite block with no LocalBusiness
top_issues: Mobile layout is fixed at 768px - the page does not collapse to a 390px phone, so the nav and hero are cut off
No LocalBusiness schema; the address, hours and phone are not machine-readable
No real online booking - 'Book Now' lands on a generic contact form with no appointment slots
Hero never says New Brunswick or gives the address above the fold
No pricing or package ranges written anywhere

agent_readiness.notes: Findable: strong review base and a claimed profile with hours, but the site exposes only a WebSite JSON-LD block. Answerable: hours, address and phone exist as text in the footer and on /contact, and the process is described; no price ranges at all. Bookable: the contact form has proper Name/Email/Phone/Message labels and no CAPTCHA, but there is no scheduler, so an agent can only send a message and wait.

operations_signals.signal: Every appointment starts with a phone call or a free-text form; the site describes staff calling the customer for fittings
Home/office visits are sold as a service - inference: travel scheduling and confirmation is manual staff work
Business correspondence runs through a Gmail address (bnatbespoke@gmail.com) - inference: inbox is shared and handled manually

top_opportunities.opportunity: Fix the mobile layout so the site renders at phone width (nav, hero and CTAs visible) - it currently stays 768px wide on a 390px screen
top_opportunities.evidence: Measured in the browser: 390px viewport, document scrollWidth 768px; screenshot shows nav and hero cut off.

top_opportunities.opportunity: Replace the contact-only 'Book Now' with a real consultation scheduler, and add LocalBusiness JSON-LD (address, hours, geo) matching the page
top_opportunities.evidence: 'Book Now' resolves to /contact; the only structured data is a WebSite block.

top_opportunities.opportunity: Automated inquiry follow-up and fitting reminders on top of the existing form and 497-review customer base
top_opportunities.evidence: Inquiry flow ends in a Gmail inbox; fittings are scheduled by outbound phone calls.

scores.reasons: Gap 4: broken mobile layout plus no scheduler or local schema on an otherwise healthy site. Ability 4: custom suits and wedding packages are high-ticket and 497 reviews prove demand. Ease 4: mobile fix and a scheduler are contained jobs. Evidence 5: everything observed directly.
